q: A U.S.-Iran ceasefire takes effect and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz is officially announced
basis: On September 25, Iran put forward a roadmap for reopening the strait within seven days, but Trump rejected it. There are also reports of a U.S. plan to resume airstrikes after the November midterm elections.
rs: Ceasefire announcements by the White House and the Iranian government, and an official announcement on reopening the strait by the Iranian government or U.S. Central Command
